title: Save up by a chosen date
description: A plan of future expenses with an amount and a deadline for each goal. The top-ups that have been marked are shown separately from what still has to be set aside.

blocks.text: People set money aside for a vacation or a yearly payment a little at a time, but the goal has to line up with the date. In one review a savings fund was the reason the app was chosen. The next hypothesis is to tie such a goal to a schedule of contributions you can follow.

quote.text: I really wanted to love EveryDollar because the layout is clean, the budgeting system is simple, and the sinking fund feature is excellent. That sinking fund option is actually the main reason I started using this app.

blocks.text: Set the amount, the date and what has already been saved, then show the plan of top-ups. Mark the actual contributions separately. After a miss, offer to revise the amount, the deadline or the remaining contributions, without passing a new plan off as progress already made.

Take one of the person’s goals and skip a planned contribution. Can they understand the consequences and choose what to change? Several goals are worth looking at together: otherwise each one on its own can look achievable while the money overall falls short.
